_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the One Hour One Life egg in pelican-eggs/games-standalone (MIT).
name: One Hour One Life
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Jason Rohrer's multiplayer survival game of parenting and civilisation building. Builds the server from the game's source at the version you choose; its settings are in the settings folder.
startup: printf '%s' "{{SERVER_PORT}}" > settings/port.ini; printf '%s' "{{SERVER_NAME}}" > settings/serverID.ini; printf '%s' "{{PASSWORD}}" > settings/clientPassword.ini; printf '%s' "{{REQUIRE_PASSWORD}}" > settings/requireClientPassword.ini; exec ./OneLifeServer

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# One Hour One Life. Builds the server from Jason Rohrer's source at its
# latest release tags (the game publishes no server binaries), with the game
# data that release needs. The world (the .db files), your settings and
# logs are never touched; the server is only replaced once the new build
# has compiled.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
gh=https://github.com/jasonrohrer

# Each repository's newest OneLife_v<N> tag, or the one asked for.
newest() { git ls-remote --tags "$gh/$1.git" | grep -oE 'OneLife_v[0-9]+$' | sort -t v -k2 -n | tail -n 1; }
code=$(newest OneLife) && gems=$(newest minorGems) && data=$(newest OneLifeData7) ||
    fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ -n "$code" ] && [ -n "$data" ] || fail "GitHub didn't list One Hour One Life's releases. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then
    v="OneLife_v${want#v}"
    git ls-remote --tags "$gh/OneLife.git" | grep -q "refs/tags/$v$" ||
        fail "One Hour One Life has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a version such as ${code#OneLife_}."
    code=$v
    # The newest data and libraries at or before that version.
    pick() { git ls-remote --tags "$gh/$1.git" | grep -oE 'OneLife_v[0-9]+$' | sort -t v -k2 -n | awk -F v -v n="${v#OneLife_v}" '$2 + 0 <= n + 0' | tail -n 1; }
    gems=$(pick minorGems)
    data=$(pick OneLifeData7)
fi
stamp="$(uname -m) $code $gems $data"

if [ -x OneLifeServer ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-ohol 2>/dev/null)" = "$stamp" ]; then
    echo "One Hour One Life ${code#OneLife_} is already installed."
else
    echo "Installing a compiler (this takes a minute)"
    apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends g++ make >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
        fail "Debian's package archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "Downloading the source of ${code#OneLife_} and data ${data#OneLife_}"
    for r in "OneLife $code" "minorGems $gems" "OneLifeData7 $data"; do
        set -- $r
        git -c advice.detachedHead=false clone -q --depth 1 --branch "$2" "$gh/$1.git" "$build/$1" ||
            fail "The download of $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."
    done
    echo "Compiling the server"
    (cd "$build/OneLife/server" && ./configure 1 >/dev/null && make -s >"$build/make.log" 2>&1) ||
        { tail -n 20 "$build/make.log"; fail "The server didn't compile. Reinstall to try again, or choose another Version."; }
    [ -x "$build/OneLife/server/OneLifeServer" ] || fail "The server didn't compile. Reinstall to try again."
    # The game data the server reads, replaced whole: a release can drop objects.
    for dir in objects transitions categories tutorialMaps contentSettings; do
        rm -rf "$dir"
        if [ -d "$build/OneLifeData7/$dir" ]; then mv "$build/OneLifeData7/$dir" "$dir"; fi
    done
    cp -f "$build/OneLifeData7/dataVersionNumber.txt" .
    echo "${code#OneLife_v}" > serverCodeVersionNumber.txt
    # Settings are added where missing, never overwritten.
    mkdir -p settings
    cp -rn "$build/OneLife/server/settings/." settings/
    cp -f "$build/OneLife/server/OneLifeServer" OneLifeServer.new
    mv -f OneLifeServer.new OneLifeServer
    echo "$stamp" > .raptor-ohol
fi
echo "Installed One Hour One Life ${code#OneLife_} with data ${data#OneLife_}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The game version to build, such as 438, or latest. Players need the same version.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The server's name: letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: Require password
variables.description: 1 asks players for the password, 0 lets anyone join.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, when it's required.
